scripts.build: npm run build -w @blaxaura/shared && npm run build -w @blaxaura/server && npm run build -w @blaxaura/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @blaxaura/server" "npm run dev -w @blaxaura/web"
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
